x: Cattrall gained us second place in the 1 Mile, and although we had 3, 4, 5, with Tom Clinton, A.
Running for Middlesex were Vic Blowfield, who had dropped out of the County race owing to shoe trouble, and Geoff Pearson, while George Lucas was in Kent colours, and A.

George Lucas was unable to be present, but how much Len had up his sleeve remains to be seen in future races. Bill Lucas was second with Ted Stimpson third, and 1st class standard medals were won by—A.

Gosney of Eastleigh beat Olney the local "crack" in the individual race, but our lads packed well with Tom Clinton 4th, Dick Towndrow 5th, Ted Stimpson 6th and Frank Abberton 7th. Other club placings were: Eric Herbert 10, Les Stokell 12, Stan Eales 14, A.
